name: PostgreSQL database software
description: Pinned PostgreSQL software identity for relational storage. Host, region, capacity, encryption configuration, application compatibility and operating costs require separate selection evidence.

provenance.notes: The pinned publisher README identifies an object-relational database management system. This supports storage_type=relational for the software identity only; no database instance, hosting service, data permissions or measured operation is implied.

AC_INIT identifies PostgreSQL 18.6. Release tag REL_18_6 resolved to this commit when checked. The released-version identity does not establish the installed patch level, a support guarantee or a successful application/backend tuple.

Publisher software/documentation permission is subject to preserving copyright, permission and disclaimer notices. No hosting, operations, backup or support rate is supplied; billing_class remains unknown for a selected storage deployment. Data rights and deployment permission are separate.
